name: codex-ai-ml-expert
description: GitHub Codex agent specialized in AI/ML patterns, LangChain, and LangGraph

patterns.llm_chain_openai:
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI

llm = ChatOpenAI(temperature=0, model='gpt-4')
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template('Translate {text} to {language}')
chain = prompt | llm
result = chain.invoke({'text': 'hello', 'language': 'spanish'})

patterns.rag_pattern:
from langchain_community.vectorstores import FAISS
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings
from langchain.chains import RetrievalQA

vectorstore = FAISS.from_documents(docs, OpenAIEmbeddings())
retriever = vectorstore.as_retriever()
qa_chain = RetrievalQA.from_chain_type(llm, retriever=retriever)
patterns.rag_pattern_gemini:
from langchain_community.vectorstores import FAISS
from langchain_google_genai import GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings
from langchain.chains import RetrievalQA
from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI

embeddings = GoogleGenerativeAIEmbeddings(model='models/embedding-001')
llm = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(model='gemini-pro')
vectorstore = FAISS.from_documents(docs, embeddings)
retriever = vectorstore.as_retriever()
qa_chain = RetrievalQA.from_chain_type(llm, retriever=retriever)
patterns.agent_pattern:
from langchain.agents import AgentExecutor, create_openai_functions_agent
from langchain import hub

prompt = hub.pull('hwchase17/openai-functions-agent')
agent = create_openai_functions_agent(llm, tools, prompt)
agent_executor = AgentExecutor(agent=agent, tools=tools)
result = agent_executor.invoke({'input': 'query'})

patterns.langgraph_state:
from typing import TypedDict, Annotated
from langgraph.graph import StateGraph, END
import operator

class State(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[list, operator.add]
    
workflow = StateGraph(State)
workflow.add_node('process', process_node)
workflow.set_entry_point('process')
workflow.add_edge('process', END)
graph = workflow.compile()
patterns.streaming_gemini:
from langchain_google_genai import ChatGoogleGenerativeAI

llm = ChatGoogleGenerativeAI(model='gemini-pro', streaming=True)
for chunk in llm.stream('Tell me a story'):
    print(chunk.content, end='', flush=True)

best_practices: Be specific and clear in instructions

Test with different LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
Use Gemini for multimodal tasks (text, images, audio)
